title: Tune the help desk AI agent against an eval set
scenario: LFG's help desk AI agent missed its go-live gate: one-word intent descriptions and a 0.9 threshold sent almost everything to analysts, and lowering the threshold made it answer from the wrong articles. Tune the agent config against a recorded, labeled eval set (scored by a documented deterministic simulator) until accuracy, containment, hallucination and latency gates pass, without overfitting a hidden holdout.
task: Run make eval and classify failures: misroute, fallback, hallucination, latency
Rewrite intent descriptions and few-shot examples within the context budget
Set the confidence threshold, retrieval topK/minScore and citation requirement
Keep temperature 0 and short answers for voice
Write an iteration log with metrics in ANSWER.md
acceptance: Visible: accuracy >= 0.85, containment >= 0.45, no hallucinations, misroutes <= 5%, p95 <= 1800 ms
Hidden holdout: accuracy >= 0.80, containment >= 0.35, gap to visible <= 0.10
No eval utterances pasted into the config
Iteration log shows each change and the metric it moved
